# package validate

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/scl/validate"
```

Package validate provides semantic validation of a parsed SCL model.

Validation is split into independent passes that each check a specific aspect of the model. All passes accept the normalized [scl.SCL](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/scl#SCL) model and a shared [index.Index](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/scl/index#Index).

## Functions

### func All

```go
func All(s *scl.SCL, idx *index.Index, indexDiags []scl.Diagnostic) []scl.Diagnostic
```

All runs every validation pass and returns the combined diagnostics. The index build diagnostics (duplicates) are included first, followed by template, IED, communication, dataset, control, topology and required-attribute checks.

### func Communication

```go
func Communication(s *scl.SCL, idx *index.Index) []scl.Diagnostic
```

Communication checks ConnectedAP references and GSE/SMV linkage. Beyond verifying IED/AP/LD existence, it checks that GSE cbName references match an actual GSEControl and SMV cbName references match an actual SMVControl in the target LN0.

### func Controls

```go
func Controls(s *scl.SCL, idx *index.Index) []scl.Diagnostic
```

Controls checks that report control blocks reference datasets that exist within their owning logical node.

### func Datasets

```go
func Datasets(s *scl.SCL, idx *index.Index) []scl.Diagnostic
```

Datasets checks dataset integrity: FCDA references resolve to real logical nodes via the index.

### func IEDs

```go
func IEDs(s *scl.SCL, idx *index.Index) []scl.Diagnostic
```

IEDs checks IED-level structure: missing LN type references. Duplicate IED/AP/LD/LN checks are already handled by [index.Build](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/scl/index#Build).

### func Templates

```go
func Templates(s *scl.SCL, idx *index.Index) []scl.Diagnostic
```

Templates checks data type template cross-references: LNodeType→DOType, DOType→DAType/EnumType/SDO, DAType→DAType/EnumType.

### func Topology

```go
func Topology(s *scl.SCL, idx *index.Index) []scl.Diagnostic
```

Topology checks substation LNode references resolve to real IED/LDevice/LN combinations via the shared index.

### func WithOptions

```go
func WithOptions(s *scl.SCL, idx *index.Index, indexDiags []scl.Diagnostic, opts Options) []scl.Diagnostic
```

WithOptions runs validation passes selected by opts.

## Types

### type Options

```go
type Options struct {
	SkipTemplates     bool
	SkipIEDs          bool
	SkipCommunication bool
	SkipDatasets      bool
	SkipControls      bool
	SkipTopology      bool
	SkipRequired      bool

	// Kind, when set, checks the content the document kind requires
	// ([scl.ValidateKind]).
	Kind scl.DocumentKind
}
```

Options controls which validation passes are executed. A zero-value Options enables all passes.
